baseline.workingTree: Includes the uncommitted header-pipeline pass; the executable identifies this baseline.

project_index.cold_build.notes: The Catalog is removed before every sample. The sample includes one refresh, bounded candidate queries, TypeScript folding, and targeted Enhanced Input decode.

project_index.warm_noop.notes: The committed SQLite snapshot is reused. Refresh still enumerates signatures, while unchanged packages should report zero changed packages, zero header reads, and zero evidence writes.
